about: The smart-guess measure (#2959, the owner's item 4 of 2026-10-29): three short invented lore documents, each split into the statements a lore read gives (a name with its other names and hidden identity, or a connection with its stored kind), with a hand-written answer: world (any ordinary inhabitant would know it) or spoiler (the player characters would have to discover it). Every name and place here is invented for this fixture.
